# Epistle of Barnabas — Chapter 17 (EMET Literal)

**Source:** Codex Sinaiticus, Epistle of Barnabas 17
**Agent:** EMET (Literal)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. It was sufficient for me that in these matters I presented these things to you simply, and that my knowledge in these regards is the knowledge that comes from faith. But since you are beloved, I will also try to explain in a few words about those things concerning which there is saving knowledge for us; and even in these things let us live a life worthy of the Lord.
2. To pass then to another teaching and doctrine. There are two ways of teaching and power — that of light, and that of darkness. And the difference between the two ways is great; for over the one have been set shining angels of God, but over the other are angels of Satan.
3. And one is the eternal Lord from before the ages and unto the ages to come, but the other is the Ruler of this present time of iniquity.
